cases.query: My repository was taken down after a DMCA complaint. Before I challenge it, what am I asserting and what legal risks should I consider?
I think code in another repository copies my work. What checks should I make before sending GitHub a DMCA takedown notice?
A repository includes information about me. Which kinds of disclosure fall outside GitHub's private-information removal process, even if I dislike them?
Our registered mark is being used in a misleading GitHub account. What information should our report give GitHub so it can investigate and understand the remedy we want?
If I submit a DMCA counter notice for disabled GitHub content, what must the notice identify and what legal commitments am I making?
I want to file a copyright takedown against part of a GitHub repository. What details make the complaint actionable, including what the owner could do to fix it?
Before asking GitHub to remove private information, how should I prepare the request and what may slow its review?
I have a complete DMCA counter notice. How should I send it, and when does the waiting period begin if I use postal mail?
A GitHub project allegedly bypasses an access control on copyrighted work. What does a circumvention complaint need to establish?
I'm reporting copied code and an exposed secret across a fork network. If GitHub disables the parent under either removal process, what happens to its forks?
A repository includes graphic depictions of violence for a documentary project. How does GitHub distinguish allowed context from prohibited violence, and can visibility be limited?
A GitHub user I was close to has died. What can an authorized person ask GitHub to do with the account, and what proof might GitHub request?
I want to automate promotion and engagement on GitHub. What behavior would count as spam or inauthentic activity?
Can I use public GitHub information for research or archiving, and what restrictions apply regardless of whether I collect it by scraping or API?
A disagreement in my repository has escalated. What conduct counts as harassment, and is every unwelcome comment treated that way?
Someone shared personal details and a photo of me on GitHub. How does the privacy rule treat public information, consent, and hostile context?
An account resembles someone else's identity. When is that impersonation, and when might a similar name or parody be allowed?
A repository posts disputed claims about health and elections. How does GitHub distinguish harmful misinformation from opinion, parody, or contextualized discussion?
I'm building a generative-media project on GitHub. Which harmful uses are barred, and how does GitHub assess what a project is meant to enable?
What are GitHub's website cookies used for, and how should I treat the published cookie list over time?
I explored a GitHub job opening and later became an employee. Can GitHub use the data it collected at the first stage for the next one?
During recruitment, with whom might GitHub share my application data, and what limits does its candidate privacy policy put on disclosure?
As a GitHub job candidate using its site, how do cookies and web beacons work, and what control do I have over them?
What information may GitHub collect automatically when I use its services or visit its site, and how do essential and optional cookies differ?
I want to participate in GitHub Community discussions. Which rules apply there, and what moderation can I expect if content breaks them?
I publish a GitHub Copilot Extension. What permission do I get to use the platform, what can GitHub do if I violate its policy, and can I appeal?
Our school participates in GitHub's Education Partner Program. What are our responsibilities for qualified users and their continued access?
I'm attending a GitHub event. What behavior is expected or prohibited under its conduct rules?
I'm registering staff and sponsors for a GitHub event. Do the conduct rules cover them, what entry conditions apply, and what happens if someone ignores a warning?
We're considering a GitHub preview for important work. What risks and service commitments should we expect before it becomes generally available?
Our procurement team wants to understand GitHub's modern-slavery and child-labor safeguards. How does it identify supplier risks and respond if it finds harm?
Can I use GitHub Actions as a general compute or delivery service, and what might GitHub do if my workflows misuse it?
A discussion in my public repository is getting abusive. What moderation options can I use before asking GitHub for help?
I'm developing a Copilot Extension that handles user data. What security and privacy boundaries does the developer policy impose?
Our company uses GitHub organizations and individual employee accounts. Who retains administrative control over each under the corporate terms?
If harassment happens at a GitHub event, where should I report urgent and non-urgent problems, and what help can staff provide?
I'm listing an app in GitHub Marketplace. Who is responsible for the app and its user license, and what rights does GitHub get to show the listing?
Our organization wants to use GitHub Marketplace. What account, age, agreement, and authority requirements apply?
An application includes open-source components. Where are its licenses documented, and when could an open-source license override GitHub's Application Terms?
A GitHub preview is listed as DPA-covered. Can we evaluate it inside our company, and does that allow production use with live customer data?
GitHub shared non-public research-program material with me. How may I use or disclose it, and what happens if disclosure is legally required?
As a secret-scanning partner, what rights do I give GitHub over token patterns, including open-source distribution and after our agreement ends?
A government asks GitHub to take down allegedly illegal content. Once GitHub gets a complete official request, what notice, appeal, geographic limits, and transparency steps follow?
Our organization is considering self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server for export-controlled material. What does the policy permit and what export limits remain?
For a legal request, what kinds of GitHub account information are public by default, optional for users to reveal, or maintained privately?
If investigators seek my GitHub account data, will GitHub tell me first, and in what situations might that notice be withheld or delayed?
What legal process does GitHub require before disclosing non-public user data, and how do subpoena requests differ from requests for access logs?
If a security incident affects GitHub and its customers, what does GitHub's SIRT handle, and what must customers handle themselves?
A GitHub employee wants to offer a customer a sports ticket or dinner. How does the gifts policy separate acceptable hospitality from improper influence?
If a project violates GPLv2 and then fixes the issue, when does GitHub's GPL cooperation commitment provide provisional or permanent reinstatement?
